Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task’s intent by strictly enforcing the “weekly” frequency criterion and concluded “neither,” despite the comparative question clearly aiming to identify which of the two titles is the Macedonian magazine. Hänt Extra is Swedish, while Tea Moderna is Macedonian (albeit monthly and defunct). Overemphasis on frequency and cessation status led to an incorrect final answer instead of selecting Tea Moderna as the Macedonian publication.
